title: Jev in 25 Lines of Python
summary: A minimalist implementation of an AI agent framework called 'Jev' using only 25 lines of Python code, demonstrating that complex LLM-powered applications can be built with simple, readable code rather than relying on heavy abstractions.
problem_solved: Makes AI agent development more accessible and understandable by stripping away complexity
why_valuable: Demonstrates that powerful AI concepts can be implemented simply, helping developers understand underlying mechanisms instead of hiding behind abstractions
